probe_detail.name: Setup commits to one misleading reading
Premise is specific rather than generic

final.name: References are load-bearing, not decorative name-drops
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the joke's references are exploited by its actual comic mechanism versus decorative, which is direct evidence of the item's comic construction.

final.name: Setup supplies exactly what the punch needs to land
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the setup logically supplies everything the punch depends on, which is core evidence of whether the joke's mechanism can resolve at all.

final.name: Economy and timing of information release before the punch
final.audit_justification: Judges economy and timing of information relative to the punch, a substantive craft property of how the joke's mechanism is executed.
final.parent: Cleanliness of commitment to one delivery format

final.name: Extent of strict conformity to one recognisable joke template
final.audit_justification: Scores strict adherence to a recognizable structural template, a formatting property, though disciplined execution of a template plausibly also reflects a more deliberate, skilled writer who produces genuinely stronger jokes.

final.name: Extent of overlap with stock circulated joke material
final.audit_justification: Measures overlap with stock circulated joke material, a fingerprint of reuse/familiarity rather than evidence of this text's own comic construction or quality.
final.parent: Reads as freshly minted rather than a circulated chestnut

final.name: Extent of dated period markers present in the text
final.audit_justification: Counts dated period/platform/topical tokens, a temporal fingerprint of production, though topicality could plausibly also make a joke genuinely funnier to contemporaneous readers via relevance.

final.name: Genuine comic invention performed by this text
final.audit_justification: Judges whether the text performs genuine inventive comic construction (a built pivot or reframing), which is direct evidence of comic merit.

final.name: Extent of clean mechanical text hygiene
final.audit_justification: Counts mechanical surface defects like typos and punctuation errors, a fingerprint of production carelessness, though an author careful enough to avoid such defects may also craft tighter, better-executed jokes.
